title: LoGo: Token-Level Dynamic Local-Global Attention
abstract: arXiv:2608.29539v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As context lengths scale, attention increasingly becomes a primary computational bottleneck in large language models. Standard Transformers remain powerful but computationally inefficient, as they allocate the same attention budget to every token regardless of its contextual demand. Existing local-global hybrids provide a more efficient alternative by mixing restricted- and full-context attention, but they typically allocate span statically across layers or heads. To address these limitations, we propose LoGo, a token-level dynamic local-global attention mechanism that uses attention span as a direct proxy for attention budget allocation. Each LoGo layer contains coupled local and global branches: all tokens receive efficient local attention over a restricted context window, while a learned gate activates global attention with full-context access only for tokens requiring long-range information. translated_title: LoGo：词元级动态局部-全局注意力机制
translated_abstract: 随着上下文长度的扩展，注意力机制日益成为大语言模型中的主要计算瓶颈。标准Transformer虽然功能强大，但计算效率低下，因为它们为每个词元分配相同的注意力预算，而不考虑其上下文需求。现有的局部-全局混合方法通过混合受限上下文注意力与全上下文注意力提供了一种更高效的替代方案，但它们通常在层或注意力头之间静态地分配跨度。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了LoGo，一种词元级动态局部-全局注意力机制，它将注意力跨度作为注意力预算分配的直接代理。每个LoGo层包含耦合的局部与全局分支：所有词元在受限的上下文窗口内接受高效的局部注意力，同时由一个可学习的门控机制仅为需要长程信息的词元激活具有全上下文访问能力的全局注意力。基于阈值的预算控制器维护……
tldr: LoGo提出了一种词元级动态局部-全局注意力机制，通过可学习门控仅为需要长程信息的词元激活全局注意力，将注意力跨度作为预算分配的直接代理，从而按需分配注意力资源并提升大语言模型处理长上下文的效率。
en_tdlr: LoGo proposes a token-level dynamic local-global attention mechanism that uses a learned gate to activate full-context global attention only for tokens requiring long-range information, treating attention span as a direct proxy for budget allocation to improve long-context efficiency in large language models.
